description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ReportTrait' that provides methods and properties for generating and managing report data, including report writer integration, statistics retrieval, and warning display.

classes.name: ReportTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing report generation utilities, including report writer setup, statistics data retrieval, worksheet creation, and warning management.

methods.name: useReportWriter
methods.description: Sets the report writer object to be used for generating reports.

methods.name: getHeadersAndDataFromStatsController
methods.description: Retrieves headers and data from a statistics controller, optionally creating one if not provided.

methods.name: createSubReport
methods.description: Creates a worksheet with provided headers and data, with optional title.

methods.name: _getReportWarningsForDisplay
methods.description: Returns warnings to be displayed, including an inaccuracy warning if enabled.
